overview_description.description:
Heru builds the community of gig-economy workers and has a suite of services that help improve their way of life and general well-being. The company's mission is to improve the conditions of independent workers by building, through technology, services, and benefits according to their needs and lifestyle.

Heru was founded in 2019 by Mateo Jaramillo and Stiven Rodriguez Sanchez and is headquartered in Mexico City, Distrito Federal, Mexico.

about_short_description.short_description: Heru is a technology platform focused on improving the quality of life for app workers and freelancers.

product.name: Plan Empresarial
product.description: A tax management plan for businesses and professionals with high income, offering a dedicated accountant, unlimited invoicing, and monthly and annual tax declarations.

product.name: Plan Freelancer
product.description: A tax management plan for independent professionals and freelancers, including monthly and annual tax declarations, automatic bank statement reconciliation, and 100 free invoices per month.

product.name: Plan Plataformas
product.description: A tax plan tailored for individuals earning income through digital platforms like Rappi, Uber, and Mercado Envíos, including monthly VAT and income tax declarations and specialized support.

product.name: Declaración Anual
product.description: A service to prepare and file the annual tax declaration with detailed expense application, investment consideration, and refund requests, reviewed by tax specialists.

product.name: Declaraciones Mensuales Atrasadas
product.description: A service to regularize overdue monthly tax declarations, combining expert accounting and AI to optimize filings and minimize economic impact.

product.name: Trámites Fiscales ante el SAT
product.description: A service managing essential tax procedures with the SAT, including RFC registration, regime changes, digital service activation, and representation before the tax authority.
